limitations: Three deterministic schedules over the same small synthetic blocks overlap; seeds identify schedules, not independent statistical replicates
Only two eight-step trajectories and two audit points; no long-run/convergence/generalization or sealed model-quality evidence
Own-trajectory drift is not local compression fidelity. No crossover, moment-only attribution or norm-only-trained trajectory comparison
No matched-time efficiency, peak memory/GPU, practical compression benefit, AttnRes or private researcher-roadmap claim
CPU reference controls/hashes retain sufficient statistics but raw theta/gradient/moment arrays are not published for independent offline numerical recomputation
SaveScope v0.1 public API remains fresh-state only; experimental history probe is separate
